Several weeks (daily tasks; minimum ~36 days to Rank IV without buying reputation)

The {wiki:Gnomes|gnomes} are losing a war against a threat from the depths and ask the dwarves for help. Enlist in the Bigfoot company through {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon, pass the recruitment tests in Gnomegate, rise in rank with daily tasks and, at the end, enter the three {wiki:Warzones} to defeat {creature:Deathstrike}, {creature:Gnomevil} and {creature:Abyssador}. You get access to the gnomes' teleport system, Gnomegate, Gnomebase Alpha and their hunting zones, lots of achievements, tokens, Gnomish Supply Packages and the Warzone loot.

The Gnomes are threatened by a hostile force that is leading this race to a slow but certain death. So they asked their dwarven allies for support. That is why the dwarves are now looking for brave warriors to join the gnomish troops and help them in this affliction. Are you willing to join the Bigfoots, the gnomish brigade fighting the evil threat?
Xelvar, north of the Kazordoon temple
The initial part (recruitment and Rank 0 and Rank I tasks) can be done on a Free Account. From **Rank II** (Gnomebase Alpha) you need a **Premium Account**.
For the Warzones you need a big, well-prepared team (they are done in a group).
Xelvar gives you 4; you spend one every time you enter or leave the GCTS. Buy more from Xelvar, Gnomette, Gnomincia or on the Market
only if you fail the written test (10 gp, from Gnominus)
to enter the Warzones (Gnomally sells it), unless you have permanent access
250 gp for the minecart ticket in Kazordoon (if you don't know the way on foot)
Access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (GCTS), the {wiki:Gnomegate}, {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} and its hunting areas, including the {wiki:Warzones}
Warzone reward chests (Crystal Coins, Crystal Shards, necklaces, rings, statue parts, Miniature House...)
Right at the start, when you ask {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon to join the gnomes ({key:join}).
Level 80. Each entry and exit of the GCTS uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal}. There are teleports in Kazordoon, Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay and Svargrond.
With {npc:Xelvar}'s permission (start of the quest), through the GCTS.
With access to the GCTS; this is the zone for Rank 0 tasks.
With access to the GCTS; this is the zone for Rank I tasks.
On reaching **Rank II** (120 reputation points), through the Gnomegate {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}.
From **Rank II**, through the southernmost teleport in Gnomebase Alpha.
From **Rank II**, through the teleport southeast of {npc:Gnomeral} in Gnomebase Alpha.
From **Rank II**, through the mushroom spiral stairs beneath Gnomebase Alpha.
On reaching **Rank IV** (1440 reputation points); you ask {npc:Gnomission} for access ({key:warzones}, {key:mission}).
Each Warzone once every 20 hours; you enter with {item:Red Teleport Crystal|Red Teleport Crystals} or, with the Gnomish War Hero mission, permanently and for free.
On reaching **Rank IV**, inside Warzones 1, 2 and 3.
You need Premium and also the level 1 crystal shield from {npc:Gnomevisor} ({wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}).
You need Premium and also the level 2 crystal shield from the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}.
You need Premium and also the level 3 crystal shield from the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest} (the deeper floors require levels 4, 5 and 6).
Picking Some Golden Fruits in the Gnomebase
After clearing the three Warzones (achievement **Dungeon Cleaner**), north of the Gnomebase depot.
Always bring plenty of {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}: you use one on each entry and exit of the GCTS.

Ask for several tasks at once and do the ones that share the same area together (for example Crystal Keeper + Raiders of the Lost Spark + Matchmaker in the Crystal Grounds; Exterminators + Mushroom Digger in the Truffels Garden).
Each task can only be handed in again **20 hours** after the last hand-in.
Exchanging {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} for reputation with {npc:Gnomally} has no 20-hour limit: it's the fastest (but costly) way to rank up.
In the Warzones always use a {item:Dwarven Ring}: drunkenness is very common.

Go to **Kazordoon** and look for {npc:Xelvar}, in the northern part of Temple Street, near the northern blessing NPC. Route: travel to Kazordoon by {wiki:Magic Carpet}, buy a minecart ticket (250 gp) from {npc:Gewen}, the carpet manager, and go northwest of the carpet to the minecart. Use it to go to the shops area. Go west to the main minecart line and use the carts to go to the **temple** (read the signs on the walls to know where each one goes). From the temple minecarts go west and then always north. Flying carpets (Premium only) leave from Darashia, Edron, Svargrond, Femor Hills, Farmine and Issavi: talk to the carpet manager and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes}. You arrive at the Kazordoon carpet, at the top of the mountain.
Xelvar is north of the Kazordoon Temple
If you already know the way to the phoenix blessing, head towards the second blessing NPC (the northern one), but keep going north when the corridor turns east.

Talk to {npc:Xelvar}: say {key:hi}, {key:adventures}, {key:recruiting}, {key:partners}, {key:gnomes}, {key:help} and {key:join}. He gives you permission to use the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} and **4 {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}**.
4 Teleport Crystals and access to the GCTS

Step into the teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}. You appear in the GCTS, above the Gnomebase (Gnomegate). Each time you enter and leave the GCTS you use up a {item:Teleport Crystal}. You can buy more from {npc:Xelvar} ({key:trade}), from {npc:Gnomette} (in the teleport room), from {npc:Gnomincia} (in Gnomebase Alpha) or on the Market.
If you get lost, {npc:Gnomette}, in the teleport room, gives you directions.
GCTS teleport in Kazordoon (next to the northern blessing NPC)
Go down to the **Gnomebase** and look for {npc:Gnomerik} in the **northwest** part of the base (recruitment office). Say {key:hi}, {key:recruitment}, {key:yes} and {key:test}.
Location in the Gnomebase: cyan = Gnomerik (recruitment office), yellow = Gnominus (bar)

The test has 16 multiple-choice questions. Answer with the letter ({key:A}, {key:B}, {key:C} or {key:D}) and, after each answer, say {key:test} to move on to the next question. You need **100 points or more** (maximum 112). For the maximum score answer, in order: **A, C, B, D, D, D, B, D, A, A, C, C, D, A, A, D**.
You find a rare, unknown mushroom
You forgot how to tie your shoelaces
You see a gnome in danger
You're guarding a valuable mushroom and you're hungry
How many bigfoots to change a light crystal
Mushroom garden infested with cave worms
What is the front part of a spear
Most needed equipment on a military campaign
The biggest disaster you can imagine
Why you want to be a bigfoot
At the end say {key:result}. If you pass, {npc:Gnomerik} sends you to talk to {npc:Gnomespector}.
If you fail: drink a Fresh Mushroom Beer

If you score under 100 points, buy a {item:Fresh Mushroom Beer} from {npc:Gnominus}, at the bar a little **southeast** of the recruitment office: say {key:hi}, {key:beer} and {key:yes} (10 gp). Drink it **right away** and go back to {npc:Gnomerik} to retake the test. You can retake it as many times as you need (but not after you've passed).
The Fresh Mushroom Beer turns into {item:Stale Mushroom Beer} after **20 seconds**, and that one no longer works to restart the exam.

Go **west** of the recruitment office and talk to {npc:Gnomespector}: say {key:hi} and {key:recruit}. Then walk through the green crystal device (the *g-rays*) to the **south**. You briefly turn into a {creature:Skeleton|skeleton}.

Keep going **south** and talk to {npc:Doctor Gnomedix} ({key:hi}). Step onto the exam platform and stand still while several comical messages appear in the Server Log. When a {item:Strange Slime} appears, the exam is done.
Keep going **south** and talk to {npc:Gnomaticus}: say {key:hi} and {key:shooting}.

Go to the small room to the **west** and climb onto a shooting platform. Right to the north you see a green {item:Crystal Glass Floor}. Every few seconds a {item:Target Dummy (Object)|Target Dummy} or an {item:Innocent Target} appears on that square. If it's a **Target Dummy**, shoot; if it's an **Innocent Target**, wait for it to disappear. You need to hit **5 Target Dummies in a row** without hitting an innocent one. The message *"You have hit enough targets. Report back!"* appears.
If you shoot an Innocent Target, the count goes back to zero.
Go back to {npc:Gnomaticus} and say {key:hi} and {key:report}.

Enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} to the **south**. Run along the path to the **west** and then always **north**. At the end there are squares that teleport you a few squares back: they only let you through after **20 times** (on the 10th you see *"<gasp>"*). Right at the end there are squares where you walk very slowly: keep running and enter the teleport at the end to go back.
Don't give up: you just have to keep walking.

In the room there are 4 {item:Large Crystal|Large Crystals}: a {item:Large Crystal (Blue)|blue} one to the **north**, a {item:Large Crystal (Red)|red} one to the **east**, a {item:Large Crystal (Green)|green} one to the **south** and a {item:Large Crystal (Cyan)|cyan} one to the **west**. Your character has its own melody: you must use the crystals in the right order and create fireworks **7 times in a row**. Notes can repeat. If you see a **red** note, you got it wrong and have to start again from the beginning.
Write down the sequence as you work it out, so you can repeat it quickly when you fail.

Talk to {npc:Gnomelvis}: {key:hi} and {key:musical}. You complete the recruitment, earn the achievement **Becoming a Bigfoot** and he marks on your map where {npc:Commander Stone} is, in the central chamber.
Leaving the Gnomebase (and coming back on the following days)

To leave, go up to the GCTS (the teleport room above the Gnomebase, where {npc:Gnomette} is) and step into the teleport of the city you want to go to: **Thais** (Ancient Temple), **Darashia** (mountain northwest of the city), **Edron** (sewers), **Kazordoon** (next to the northern blesser), **Liberty Bay** (mountains to the southeast) or **Svargrond** (hole next to the west exit). You use up a {item:Teleport Crystal}. To come back for the daily tasks, step into the GCTS teleport in one of those cities (you use up another {item:Teleport Crystal}) and go down from the GCTS to the Gnomebase.
GCTS in Darashia (mountain to the northwest)
GCTS in Liberty Bay (mountains to the southeast)
GCTS in Svargrond (hole next to the west exit)
The GCTS can only be used from level 80. Always bring spare Teleport Crystals so you don't get stuck in the Gnomebase.

From here on the quest is made of daily tasks. The tasks available depend on your reputation (renown) with the gnomes. You rank up automatically on reaching the required reputation, and each rank gives an achievement.
The first three ranks unlock new tasks; the fourth gives access to the {wiki:Warzones}.

Each task can be repeated **20 hours** after the last hand-in and gives reputation, tokens and a {item:Gnomish Supply Package}. The first time you do each one you earn an achievement. You can accept all the tasks at once and do them together to save time.

Each {item:Minor Crystalline Token} is worth **5 reputation points**. Talk to {npc:Gnomally}: say {key:hi}, {key:relations}, {key:yes}, the number of tokens you want to exchange (for example {key:2}) and {key:yes}. This exchange has no 20-hour limit.

Available from the start. Ask for them from {npc:Commander Stone}, in the central chamber of the Gnomebase, with {key:hi} and {key:mission}. To hand in, say {key:hi}, {key:report} and the name of the task.
Say {key:keeper} to {npc:Commander Stone}. You receive a {item:Gnomish Repair Crystal}.
Do this task at the same time as Raiders of the Lost Spark (Rank 0) and Matchmaker (Rank II): they are all in the Crystal Grounds.

Go to the {wiki:Crystal Grounds} (in the north, about 20 sqm south of {npc:Gnomally}). Use the {item:Gnomish Repair Crystal} on {item:Damaged Crystal|Damaged Crystals} until you repair **5**. You enter through the Crystal Grounds {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}, in the Gnomegate. When you're done, go back to that teleport to return to the Gnomegate.
Watch out for {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals}.
Go back to {npc:Commander Stone} and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:keeper}.
1 Minor Crystalline Token, Gnomish Supply Package, 5 reputation and the Crystal Keeper achievement
Say {key:spark} to {npc:Commander Stone}. You receive a {item:Gnomish Extraction Crystal}.
Raiders of the Lost Spark: extract 7 sparks
In the {wiki:Crystal Grounds}, kill {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystal Crushers} (they're everywhere) and use the {item:Gnomish Extraction Crystal} on their corpses. Do this **7 times**.
Use the extractor on a Crystal Crusher's corpse
Go back to {npc:Commander Stone} and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:spark}.
1 Minor Crystalline Token, Gnomish Supply Package, 5 reputation and the Call Me Sparky achievement

On reaching 30 reputation you rank up to Rank I and earn the achievement **Gnome Little Helper**. Both tasks are done in the {wiki:Truffels Garden} (north teleport in the Gnomebase), so do them together.
Say {key:digging} to {npc:Commander Stone}. You receive a {item:Little Pig}.
The Little Pig disappears after **1 hour**. If that happens you have to buy another from {npc:Gnomally} and restart the feeding.
Step into the **north** teleport of the Gnomebase to go to the {wiki:Truffels Garden}. It's a Gnomegate {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}.
Here you find {creature:Wiggler|Wigglers}, {creature:Massive Earth Elemental|Massive Earth Elementals} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}.
Kill **10** {creature:Wiggler|Wigglers}; they're spread all over the cave.
From Rank II you can also do this task in the {wiki:Mushroom Gardens}, but it's not worth it: in the Truffels Garden you do Exterminators and Mushroom Digger at the same time.
Mushroom Digger: feed the little pig 3 times

In the cave you find {creature:Mushroom Sniffer|Mushroom Sniffers}. Lure them onto the {item:Mold Floor (Truffels)}. With luck {item:Some Truffels} appear; otherwise the floor turns into {item:Churned Ground}. Use the {item:Little Pig} on **three** sets of truffles.
Use the Little Pig on the truffles
Leave the {wiki:Truffels Garden} through the teleport you entered by, go back to {npc:Commander Stone} and say {key:hi}, {key:report}, {key:extermination}; then {key:report} and {key:digging}.
For each task: 1 Minor Crystalline Token, Gnomish Supply Package and 5 reputation. Achievements One Foot Vs. Many and The Picky Pig

On reaching 120 reputation you rank up to Rank II and earn the achievement **Gnome Friend**. From here you need a **Premium Account**. You gain access to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha}, where {npc:Gnomeral} gives the new tasks ({key:hi}, {key:mission}; to hand in, {key:report} and the name of the task).

At the Gnomegate, step into the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} that leads to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} (only works from Rank II, with a Premium Account) and look for {npc:Gnomeral}, in the **west** part of the base. To go back to the Gnomegate, use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia}.
Gnomincia, next to the teleport back to Gnomegate
Location of Gnomeral and the Golem Workshop
The Tinker's Bell: ring the bell on 4 golems

Go to the {wiki:Golem Workshop} (the teleport furthest **south**). Use the {item:Bell} on **living** {creature:Damaged Crystal Golem|Damaged Crystal Golems} (not on {creature:Enraged Crystal Golem|Enraged Crystal Golems}). Repeat until you've teleported **four**.
Use the bell on a Damaged Crystal Golem
Sort the battle list by name ("Sort Ascending by Name") to find the Damaged Crystal Golems faster.
Leave the {wiki:Golem Workshop} through the teleport you entered by, go back to {npc:Gnomeral} and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:repair}.
2 Minor Crystalline Tokens, Gnomish Supply Package, 5 reputation and the Substitute Tinker achievement
Say {key:matchmaker} to {npc:Gnomeral}. You receive a package with a crystal.
Matchmaker: open the package and go to the Crystal Grounds

Open the package to take out the {item:Lonely Crystal} and go to the {wiki:Crystal Grounds}. The Crystal Grounds are in the Gnomegate: go back there through the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} and step into the Crystal Grounds {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}.
Watch out for {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals}.

Look for a {item:Large Crystal (Red)} and use your crystal on it. Only one of them matches yours; if it doesn't work, try another. These are the positions of the Large Crystals on the first floor of the cave.

If none on the first floor fits, go down and try the ones on the second floor. Keep going until you see the message *"Congratulations! The crystals seem to have fallen in love and your mission is done!"*.

The game doesn't give you a fixed Large Crystal: you randomly receive a crystal that has a set partner. To find out which one it is, put the {item:Lonely Crystal} on an {wiki:Action Bars|Action Button} and create a map mark on the matching crystal with the same name (Button 1, Button 2, etc.). That way you go straight to the right crystal. Another option: keep a Lonely Crystal that matches one of the crystals near the entrance and always use that one, ignoring what you receive. You can trade Lonely Crystals with other players or keep them after the task.
Identify the crystal using the Action Bar

Leave the Crystal Grounds through the teleport you entered by, take the teleport to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} at the Gnomegate, go back to {npc:Gnomeral} and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:matchmaker}.
2 Minor Crystalline Tokens, Gnomish Supply Package, 10 reputation and the Crystals in Love achievement
On reaching 480 reputation you rank up to Rank III and earn the achievement **Gnomelike**.
Say {key:spore} to {npc:Gnomeral}. You receive a {item:Gnomish Spore Gatherer (Red)}.
If you haven't finished the Exterminators task in the Truffels Garden yet, you can do the last Wiggler kills here.
Spore Gathering: go to the Mushroom Gardens

Go to the {wiki:Mushroom Gardens}, beneath Gnomebase Alpha: head **south** from the base and go down the ramp, take a few steps **north** and go down the mushroom spiral stairs (Mushroom Corkscrew Stairs).

{creature:Wiggler|Wigglers} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} everywhere; {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} in the farms to the west; {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} and {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers} in the farms to the east.
Spiral stairs to the Mushroom Gardens
Spore Gathering: collect the spores in the right order

Use {item:Puffball Mushroom|Puffball Mushrooms} to make coloured spores appear above them: they can be {item:Red Spores|red}, {item:Green Spores|green}, {item:Blue Spores|blue} or {item:Yellow Spores|yellow}. Look at your container to see which colour you need now. If it's the right colour, use the kit on the spores; if not, look for another mushroom. The correct order is **red → green → blue → yellow**. At the end you have a {item:Gnomish Spore Gatherer (Complete)}.
Collect spores from a Puffball Mushroom
If you use the kit on a spore of the wrong colour you ruin it and have to restart from the first colour. Each mushroom can only be used again after 2 minutes.

You can buy Gnomish Spore Gatherers from {npc:Gnomally} for 50 gp and fill them in bulk: the spores don't disappear when used (enough for 5–6 collections per mushroom) and the gatherers never expire. The game only checks that you have a complete gatherer.
Climb back up the same spiral stairs and the ramp to Gnomebase Alpha, go back to {npc:Gnomeral} and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:spore}.
2 Minor Crystalline Tokens, Gnomish Supply Package, 10 reputation and the Spore Hunter achievement
Say {key:grindstone} to {npc:Gnomeral}. He sends you to the {wiki:Hot Spot} (the teleport is **southeast** of Gnomeral).
Location of the teleport to the Hot Spot
**You have 1 hour** to hand in. If the deadline passes you don't receive the Gnomish Supply Package and only earn 5 reputation instead of 10.
Grindstone Hunt: pick up the Whetstone

In the Hot Spot look for {item:Strange Stone|Strange Stones} floating in the lava. Every 75 seconds they rise to the surface as {item:Whetstones} and sink again 17 seconds later. Use the Whetstones while they are on the surface; you rarely receive a {item:Whetstone}.
Use the Whetstone when it's on the surface
Here there are {creature:Vulcongra|Vulcongras}, {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}.
Leave the {wiki:Hot Spot} through the teleport you entered by and go back to {npc:Gnomeral} within the hour and say {key:hi}, {key:report} and {key:grindstone}.
2 Minor Crystalline Tokens, Gnomish Supply Package, 10 reputation and the Grinding Again achievement

On reaching 1440 reputation you rank up to Rank IV and earn the achievement **Honorary Gnome**. The three Warzones are the end of the quest and each is harder than the last. You have to complete one to be able to enter the next.

Talk to {npc:Gnomission}: say {key:hi}, {key:warzones} and {key:mission}. Each Warzone can only be done once every **20 hours**, and normal Teleport Crystals don't work on these teleports: you need {item:Red Teleport Crystal|Red Teleport Crystals} (mission crystals), which you buy from {npc:Gnomally}.

To unlock the next Warzone you **must** hit the boss **and** stay in the room until it dies, and you must open the reward chest before entering the next Warzone. Hitting the boss gives you the chest, but the room's exit teleport only gives access if the boss is dead.

Use a {item:Red Teleport Crystal} (if you haven't handed in the {item:Deathstrike's Snippet} yet) and enter the first Warzone. You appear in an antechamber with no monsters, with an NPC who explains the mission (you don't need to talk to him). When the team is ready, step into the teleport **east** of the antechamber. The Warzone teleports are in the **east** part of Gnomebase Alpha.

Here you face many {creature:Humongous Fungus} and {creature:Hideous Fungus}, and now and then {creature:Armadile|Armadiles} and {creature:Stone Devourer|Stone Devourers}. The monsters come in big groups and attack whoever does the most damage to them: druids and sorcerers can easily be crushed.
Follow the cave path as shown on the map until you reach the **easternmost** point, where there is a green crystal statue.
The path to follow in Warzone 1

If the team includes strangers, be careful at the last bend: someone may run ahead and trigger the waves too early, with no way to stop it. It's very dangerous if the team is still running to position.

Use the green crystal statue. Every 20 seconds a wave of 5–6 fungi appears. After **10 waves** (200 seconds) a teleport appears **3 sqm east** of the statue. Step into it to reach the boss room. The teleport stays open for about 1 minute; when it closes, the boss appears.

Plan the strategy beforehand. On Optional PvP and Open PvP (dove mode) the easiest is for everyone to stack 3 sqm east and 1 sqm south of the statue, closed in with Magic Walls. On other servers, block as many spawns as possible with players and kill the ones that appear.

{creature:Deathstrike} is the boss (the second hardest of the three). It has strong healing, so you need a lot of damage to kill it within the **30 minutes** the team has. It focuses whoever does the most damage: blockers must stay right next to it even while taking its beams, otherwise it runs to the mages. If it's too much, you can escape through the portal to the **southeast** of the room.
If you enter the boss room you can't enter again for 20 hours, even if the team fails or dies.

After defeating Deathstrike you get access to the reward chest, just **north** of the Warzone 1 teleport. You can open it every time you defeat it, as long as you've damaged it. You receive, among other things, {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, 2 {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major Crystalline Tokens} and items like {item:Mucus Plug}, {item:Gill Necklace} or parts of the Deathstrike statue (see the chest table at the end).
Final Strike achievement (1st opening) and Death on Strike (50 openings)
Warzone 2: break through to the barred teleport

Fight your way to the teleport with bars. Lure an {creature:Infected Weeper} (you find one along the way) and keep it next to the bars. When it summons {creature:Parasite|Parasites}, kill them **1 sqm in front of the bars**. If you do it right, the bars get damaged. Do this **3 times** in a short time and the wall is destroyed.

Here there are {creature:Magma Crawler|Magma Crawlers}, {creature:Lava Golem|Lava Golems}, {creature:Lost Berserker|Lost Berserkers}, {creature:Weeper|Weepers} and {creature:Infected Weeper|Infected Weepers}. It's the easiest Warzone, but lots of monsters can kill an inattentive player in a single blow.

Don't block the Infected Weeper's path to the bars: stay north or south of the bars, or in the room to the west. Trap it with {item:Energy Wall Rune|energy walls}: at least three walls, two columns 2 and 3 sqm west of the bars and one column 1 sqm east (the Infected Weeper can summon through the bars; players can't stand on those positions).
Warzone 2: order of attack on the monsters
Bring energy walls: they block all the monsters in this Warzone. Priorities:
Kill first. Paladins and knights stand between the Weepers and the mages, even while taking beams. They switch target to the weakest mage almost every turn; challenge barely works.
Stay diagonal; they're easier to control.
Not very dangerous, but they force you to use a {item:Dwarven Ring} for the whole Warzone.
Last. They attack from range with beams and an area fire attack; avoid the beams and catch them with area attacks.

Get into the teleport quickly, because the wall regenerates to a previous damage state (it doesn't go back to new right away). Trap the {creature:Gnomevil} as early as possible: it appears east of the tar. Paladins and knights must **always** stay right next to it: it attacks whoever does the most damage to it and, if the blockers move, it runs off and (usually) kills the strongest mage. The Gnomevil can't slip diagonally past a player who blocks it, nor does it switch target to that player.
The blockers take a lot of mana drain: bring protection against {wiki:Mana Drain}.
Achievements Gnomebane's Bane (1st time) and Fall of the Fallen (50 times)
Warzone 3: get to the mound of earth
Fight your way to the end of the Warzone, where there is an empty room with a mound of earth.
Here you face {creature:Orewalker|Orewalkers}, {creature:Cliff Strider|Cliff Striders}, {creature:Ironblight|Ironblights} and {creature:Lost Berserker|Lost Berserkers}.

Step on the mound of earth to make {creature:Versperoth} appear. He appears for 20 seconds and disappears for 10, several times. Every time he disappears about 10 {creature:Minion of Versperoth|Minions of Versperoth} spawn (Lava Golems that give no loot and less experience, and live about 20 seconds). When Versperoth appears, deal him as much damage as you can.
This is probably the hardest part of the Warzones, not counting the bosses.
When Versperoth dies a teleport appears on the mound of earth where he died. The minions don't die: run to the teleport (it disappears after a while) and face {creature:Abyssador}.
On opening the chest: achievements Death from Below (1st time) and Diplomatic Immunity (50 times)

In each Warzone, once the boss is dead, leave the room through the exit teleport. That teleport only gives you access to the next Warzone if the boss is **dead**, so stay in the room until the end. In Warzone 1, if the team gives up, escape through the portal to the **southeast** of the {creature:Deathstrike} room. Then go and open the reward chest (the Warzone 1 one is just **north** of the Warzone 1 teleport) before attempting the next Warzone. To leave Gnomebase Alpha, use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} and then the GCTS.
The {creature:Magma Crawler|Magma Crawlers} and {creature:Lava Golem|Lava Golems} in Warzone 2 leave you with strong Soulfire: if needed, ask a temple priest for help when you leave.
After clearing all three Warzones you earn the achievement **Dungeon Cleaner** and can pick {item:Some Golden Fruits} **north** of the Gnomebase depot.
Dungeon Cleaner achievement and access to the Some Golden Fruits

The Warzone bosses drop products that prove you killed them (you can loot them or buy them from other players). Hand them in to {npc:Gnomission}: say {key:hi}, {key:job}, {key:hero} and then {key:snippet}, {key:hat} or {key:lash}. You get permanent, free access to the matching Warzone (you stop spending Red Teleport Crystals), but the 20-hour limit for entering the boss room stays. He only accepts the item if you already have access to that Warzone (you don't need to have completed it).
On handing in all three: achievement Gnomish Art Of War
If you plan to do the Warzones many times, it's worth buying the {item:Deathstrike's Snippet} (always dropped by Deathstrike) to get permanent access to Warzone 1.
From each chest you always get **5 of the 9 possible items**, but never more than one statue part at a time, and the chance of getting the {item:Miniature House} is very low.
